scope: All eight laboratory tools directory families, orchestration and optional simulator; reusable code with fresh-user configuration

toolkits.purpose: Core jobs, exact receipt preflight, brief/registry checks and lineage findings
toolkits.requirements: Core plus POSIX/Git for receipts; explicit project receipts and formats for advanced checks

toolkits.purpose: Launcher, context, Conscience and toolkit discovery
Source-bound reading maps and declared correction lineage
toolkits.requirements: POSIX; caller-selected corpus; maps do not replace sources

toolkits.purpose: Explicit note records, typed links, lexical retrieval and bounded packets
toolkits.requirements: Single writer; caller-selected store; no private memory included

toolkits.purpose: Persistent source handles, freshness, expansion and explicit rebinding
toolkits.requirements: Caller-selected fold/root; invented example replaces historical workstream

toolkits.purpose: Task checkpoints, pinned verification, evidence preservation and compact-context skill
toolkits.requirements: Explicit regular files; no native context-window control or background service

toolkits.purpose: Git-backed file transport, observation and explicitly admitted worker code
toolkits.requirements: POSIX and Git; own remote/branch/state; worker requires separate explicit job admission

toolkits.purpose: Explicit Git export allowlist, local history backup and isolated recovery verification
toolkits.requirements: Git; source archive requires committed UTF-8 text; private bundle is not for publication; no historical manifest supplied

toolkits.purpose: Kernel20/legacy plans and Kernel21 custody/preflight tools
toolkits.requirements: Explicit project root and configuration; proposals do not execute changes
Overview help needs no optional packages; subcommand help and execution require the numerical environment; no automatic run

toolkits.purpose: Deterministic ZIP/tar distribution builder and onboarding checks
toolkits.requirements: Git for build; no Git needed to use downloaded core

excluded_state: Private corpora, memory stores, transcripts, credentials and host grants
Historical workstream folds, mailbox jobs/admissions/cache and output records
Host-specific LaunchAgent/Codex service configuration and Notion account bindings
Laboratory migration map and historical canon; advanced Yggdrasil uses caller-supplied source/canon
Legacy Node orchestrator API prototype (not a verified runnable toolkit; see docs/orchestrator.md)
